Release CustomResourceDefinition manifests of three upstream projects, at every
final release tag of two consecutive release lines each, fetched from the upstream
git repositories by commit (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/blob/<commit>/<path>).
They are the oracle inputs of the crd.version-removal extractor for the removals
measured upstream: Cilium 1.19 -> 1.20 (CiliumNodeConfig v2alpha1), Kyverno
1.15 -> 1.16 (UpdateRequest v1beta1) and Longhorn 1.8 -> 1.9 (fifteen v1beta1
versions).

Modifications: the body of every version's "schema:" key was replaced by a minimal
object schema ("openAPIV3Schema: type: object"); in deploy/longhorn.yaml every
document that is not a CustomResourceDefinition was removed. Every other line is
unchanged, so names, groups, kinds, version order and the served and storage flags
are the upstream ones; line numbers and file digests differ from upstream. Only the
paths the extractor lists are included (the rest of each repository tree is not), so
the full-tree scan of the extractor sees no file outside them in these fixtures.

The sha256 below is the digest of the unmodified upstream file.

Licence: Apache-2.0, Copyright Authors of Cilium; see LICENSES/Source-Cilium-Apache-2.0.txt and THIRD-PARTY.md
(Modified upstream test fixtures).
